jobs.prompt: Follow-up for T-8016 on this branch (main with #264 is merged in: the board token is accepted only as the x-watch-token header or the per-port swarm_watch_<port> cookie; ?t= is refused on every non-page route). Two things. (1) Regression: removing money also removed the 'NO CAP' warning from tools/watch-assets/run-kpis.js; tests/project-spend.test.mjs ('no project cap ... swarm watch says NO CAP') requires the run Watch page to say NO CAP when the project has no cap. Restore it as a plain warning with no amount (driven by a non-money boolean such as noCap; make sure stripMoney in tools/watch-cli.mjs and the watch-server payload keep a boolean noCap field: it is not money). (2) Make tests/board-no-money.test.mjs generic, as the release owner asked: export from tools/watch-server.mjs a frozen list of every GET route it serves (pages and APIs, e.g. WATCH_ROUTES) built from the same arrays the router uses, then in the test start a real server (board mode with data that HAS spend: runs with costUsd, spend files, a cap) and request EVERY route in that list with the x-watch-token header, plus an /events snapshot and one delta; fail if any JSON payload has a money-shaped key or any response body contains a dollar-shaped value (regex /\$\s?\d/ ; list the allowed exceptions, if any, explicitly in the test); keep the scan of every board browser script; replace every ?t= in the test with the header. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-no-money.test.mjs tests/project-spend.test.mjs tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/watch-*.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
